findings.finding: Original observed executable hash was recorded but not enforced. Current required input map pins executable, input file arguments and concrete job/assets, checked before acquisition, immediately before command launch and after completion.
First hash fix misclassified the newly created completion output as an unpinned input at postcheck. Exact declared output is now exempt; initial freshness and all other input checks remain enforced.

supported_guarantees: Uses the same stable lockf mutation lock and compatible atomic holder symlink/owner file and FIFO ticket namespace as captured Sushi protocol. Busy, malformed, uncertain owners or any pending ticket block before the reviewed GPU command.
Never breaks/prunes another lease or ticket and never signals processes. Release requires own symlink/inode/holder/content identities plus successful reviewed completion and observed child cleanup.
Failed/interrupted/uncertain cleanup retains own lease and recovery receipt rather than advertising the GPU as free.

Both concrete requests bind all31 captured input file hashes and precise expected numerical completion. Expected negative exit1 alone is not accepted without completed numerical fields and absent error.
limits: These are CPU tests and source review; real cross-process race behavior on the M5 mutation lock has not been stress tested.

Process polling cannot prove absence of an unsampled child that detached and reparented between samples. The concrete reviewed Swift controls are single-process and must not launch detached background work; the generic wrapper is not a universal process containment mechanism.
Remote files were not read by this reviewer. Local request hashes were compared with the captured parent inventory; the actual wrapper enforces those hashes on the M5 before and after execution.
Shared-lease cooperation cannot prevent unrelated software that ignores this lock from using the GPU. New command types require their own lifecycle and input-closure review.

This gate authorizes only the scoped golden/negative control attempt. Actual numeric result and receipt identities still need post-run review; no model training or generated-kernel quality conclusion follows.
